description: APIs that exist on Deno but throw or silently do nothing when called, modules the compatibility matrix does not cover, and matrix differences that are values rather than behavior. Curated by reading Deno's ext/node polyfills at the release the matrix was generated with; stubs call notImplemented.

child_process.note: implemented; the compatibility matrix does not cover node:child_process

cluster.note: is a stub on Deno: fork, disconnect, setupPrimary and the Worker constructor throw Not implemented

domain.note: implemented; the compatibility matrix does not cover node:domain

inspector.note: implemented; the compatibility matrix does not cover node:inspector

inspector/promises.note: implemented; the compatibility matrix does not cover node:inspector/promises

punycode.note: implemented; the compatibility matrix does not cover node:punycode

readline.note: implemented; the compatibility matrix does not cover node:readline

readline/promises.note: implemented; the compatibility matrix does not cover node:readline/promises

repl.note: implemented; the compatibility matrix does not cover node:repl

test.note: implemented; the compatibility matrix does not cover node:test

trace_events.note: is a stub: createTracing returns an object without enable or disable, and getEnabledCategories always returns an empty string

tty.note: implemented; the compatibility matrix does not cover node:tty

v8.note: implemented; the compatibility matrix does not cover node:v8

vm.note: implemented; the compatibility matrix does not cover node:vm

wasi.note: is a stub on Deno: constructing WASI throws "Context is currently not supported"

worker_threads.note: implemented; the compatibility matrix does not cover node:worker_threads

process.setSourceMapsEnabled.note: does nothing; source maps are always enabled

fs.F_OK.note: missing on Deno, but an undefined mode of fs.access is F_OK, so `fs.access(path, fs.F_OK, cb)` works the same. R_OK, W_OK and X_OK stay missing, because an undefined mode checks only that the file exists

process.sourceMapsEnabled.note: always true, since source maps are always enabled

process.release.note: defined as a getter, which the compatibility matrix does not see

process.config.note: holds Node's build configuration; its keys are values, not APIs

process.versions.note: lists the versions of Node's bundled dependencies, which Deno does not have

process.stdin.note: the matrix recorded Node's stdio as sockets; Deno's are plain streams when not attached to a TTY

process.stdout.note: the matrix recorded Node's stdio as sockets; Deno's are plain streams when not attached to a TTY

process.stderr.note: the matrix recorded Node's stdio as sockets; Deno's are plain streams when not attached to a TTY

*globals*.GPUDeviceLostInfo.note: the Web API data lists it as missing, but it exists on Deno

*globals*.GPUInternalError.note: the Web API data lists it as missing, but it exists on Deno

*globals*.GPUOutOfMemoryError.note: the Web API data lists it as missing, but it exists on Deno

*globals*.GPUValidationError.note: the Web API data lists it as missing, but it exists on Deno

*globals*.Location.note: the Web API data lists it as missing, but it exists on Deno

*globals*.PerformanceObserver.supportedE.note: the Web API data lists it as missing, but it exists on Deno

process.uptime.note: the matrix recorded the named export of node:process, which lacks it; the global process and the default export have it. This also hides the error for a named import, because edgefit cannot tell the two apart

process.binding.note: the matrix recorded the named export of node:process, which lacks it; the global process and the default export have it. This also hides the error for a named import, because edgefit cannot tell the two apart

process.title.note: the matrix recorded the named export of node:process, which lacks it; the global process and the default export have it. This also hides the error for a named import, because edgefit cannot tell the two apart

*globals*.caches.keys.note: the Web API data lists it as missing, but it exists on Deno

*globals*.caches.match.note: the Web API data lists it as missing, but it exists on Deno
